---
title: "Schedules and widgets"
---

## Schedules

Scheduling is part of the shared runtime rather than a capability-specific subsystem. The core registry currently contributes scheduler create/export/import methods and their screens alongside discovered module methods.

Schedules should invoke canonical capability/preset/protocol contracts. Their eventual closeout rules should mirror the same origin-aware semantics as direct runs.

## Widgets

The intended Android desktop widget patterns are:

- 1×1 preset trigger;
- 1×1 protocol trigger;
- 1×1 schedule toggle.

A widget does not create a new capability path. It records a different launch origin. If an interactive capability opens, it uses its normal polished screen and Done returns to the Android desktop.
